modules.module_title: Process of Making Namda Cushion Covers

pcs.pc_description: select high-quality wool in various colors for design and texture.
use a sturdy cotton or felt fabric as the base for the cushion cover.
draw unique patterns or motifs for the cushion cover, drawing inspiration from nature or traditional designs
choose colors that complement each other and align with the intended aesthetic
cut wool into strips or pieces according to the design
dye the wool strips using natural dyes to achieve vibrant colors
cut the base fabric to the desired size of the cushion cover
sew the edges of the base fabric to prevent fraying
lay wool strips in a layered fashion on the base fabric, ensuring they cover the entire area
use moisture and pressure (rolling or beating) to mat the wool fibers together, creating a cohesive felt layer
trim excess wool and shape the cover as needed
add zippers or buttons for easy removal and washing

modules.module_title: Process of Making Namda Dining Mats

pcs.pc_description: choose durable wool and cotton fabric for the dining mats
gather natural dyes for the coloring wool
choose geometric or floral patterns that can be repeated across the mat
use a strong base fabric, such as canvas or felt, to support the wool
cut the base fabric into desired sizes for dining mats
lay wool strips on the base fabric, ensuring an even distribution
use warm soapy water and agitation to felt the wool fibers together, forming a dense mat
use a felting needle to create intricate designs and textures on the surface
sew additional wool shapes onto the mat for added design elements
sew around the edges to create a neat finish and prevent fraying
add a non-slip backing for better stability when placed on tables
check for loose threads, secure all embellishments, and ensure the mat is evenly felted
clean the finished product to remove any residues from the felting process
